tests: after Cancel in New Project Options of Import from VBP..., the next template's box is drawn as an import: a Unicode row, and no Include Common Controls
after that Cancel, a sample's box is drawn as an import too

Continue in that box gives a project with no WinNativeCommonCtls reference, the template's description and title in place of the name, and Unicode Common Control Notifications on; the project is otherwise normal
steps:
1. File > New Project..., Import from VBP..., any .vbp. Press Cancel in New Project Options.
2. File > New Project..., double-click Standard EXE. The box has a Unicode Common Control Notifications row and no Include Common Controls row. The same for a sample.
3. Type a name and press Continue. The project has no WinNativeCommonCtls reference, its description and title are New project, not the name, and runtime.useUnicodeCommonControlNotifications is true.
4. The next box is right again.
Controls: the same card in a fresh IDE; Cancel in the import's own picker leaves the next box right.
